description: Two turns with different effort levels and models, so the call parameters vary in one session.
steps: claude --effort high -p --output-format json --permission-mode bypassPermissions --strict-mcp-config --session-id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007 "Without tools: a train leaves at 09:47 and the trip takes 2 h 38 min. When does it arrive? Time only."

claude --effort low --model sonnet -p --output-format json --permission-mode bypassPermissions --strict-mcp-config --resume 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007 "And if the trip took 25 minutes longer? Time only."
